prompt: Ultra-realistic luxury beauty-editorial macro photograph. Two elegant feminine hands softly overlapped in a relaxed natural pose, nails as the clear hero of the shot. Long almond nails, perfectly manicured, clean cuticles, flawless high-gloss gel finish. Each nail is divided into flowing curved 'stained glass' sections outlined in raised silver chrome lines, filled with rich color, with small clustered rhinestones and crystals placed along the metallic lines. Every nail is slightly different but the full set is one coordinated design. Color palette: Icy Cerulean Blue, Pearl Silver, Frosted Ivory, 24K Gold. Design: Almond-shaped nails alternate glossy Icy Cerulean and frosted-matte Fros ted Ivory bases. Ring and middle nails are layered with a sheer Pearl Silver jelly, scattered 24K gold leaf flakes and thin silver metallic striping at the smile line; tiny crystal snowflake clusters are placed at the cuticle and one fine silver stud accents each thumb for winter sparkle. Technique emphasis: gold leaf flakes. Seasonal mood (winter): snowflake and crystal accents, velvet and frost effects. Background: soft white faux fur, out of focus. Anatomically correct hands: exactly five fingers on each hand, natural knuckles, realistic skin texture and pores, natural proportions, deep brown skin tone. Nails razor sharp and in focus, shallow depth of field on the background. Soft warm studio lighting with gentle specular highlights on the gloss. Tall vertical composition with the hands centered and empty space on the left and right edges (the image will be cropped to 9:16). No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names.
